verdict.rationale: The API supports the core agent loop: create an applicant, create a workflow run that returns a token, then retrieve results by webhook or polling (docs-3, docs-4). Auth uses short-lived OAuth client-credentials tokens with granular control over scope of access (docs-6, docs-14, docs-29), and an llms.txt index aids agent consumption (probe-1). Missing for 10: explicit evidence of triggering re-checks, detailed docs on retrieving extracted document data, any MCP surface, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
